_comment: Banner names as the community sheet spells them -> the name summon_pool.nameEn uses. Keys and values are compared normalised (lowercased, accents and punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed), so exact casing does not matter. Only real wording differences belong here; a whitespace, tab or '!' difference is handled by the normaliser.
